title: EFD Unit 5 · Part 1 · Process and Department Terms

text.en: Welcome to English for Furniture Designers. This is Unit 5, Making a Piece: Steps and Process.
text.ar: أهلاً بكم في الإنجليزية لمصمّمي الأثاث. هذه الوحدة الخامسة، صناعة القطعة: الخطوات والعمليّة.

text.en: This is Part 1, Process and Department Terms. You will define seven terms and fill a table of departments.
text.ar: هذا الجزء الأوّل، مصطلحات العمليّة والأقسام. ستعرّف سبعة مصطلحات وتملأ جدول أقسام.

text.en: Seven terms today. One meaning will be left over.
text.ar: سبعة مصطلحات اليوم. سيبقى معنى واحد زائداً.

text.en: The first is done. A prototype is the first sample made to test a design.
text.ar: الأوّل محلول. النموذج الأوّليّ أوّل عيّنة تُصنع لاختبار تصميم.

text.en: What does assemble mean?
To put the parts together to make the piece.
What does upholster mean?
To add foam and fabric to a seat.
What is finishing?
The last work: sanding, varnish, and cleaning.
What is quality control?
Checking that the furniture is good and correct.
text.ar: التحقّق من أنّ الأثاث جيّد وصحيح.

text.en: What is a department?
One part of the workshop that does one job.
text.ar: جزء من الورشة يؤدّي عملاً واحداً.

text.en: What is a production line?
The order of steps that makes a product.
What is a stage?
One step in a process.
The leftover meaning was the room where customers buy furniture.
text.ar: المعنى الزائد كان الغرفة التي يشتري فيها الزبائن الأثاث.

text.en: That is the showroom, from Unit 1. It is not a stage.
text.ar: تلك صالة العرض، من الوحدة الأولى. ليست مرحلة.

text.en: A stage and a department are easy to confuse.
A stage is a step in time. A department is a place with people.
text.ar: المرحلة خطوة في الزمن. والقسم مكان فيه أناس.

text.en: Now a table. Which department, and what happens there?
text.ar: الآن جدول. أيّ قسم، وماذا يحدث فيه؟

text.en: Cutting is done in the workshop: the wood is cut into pieces.
text.ar: القطع يتمّ في الورشة: يُقطع الخشب إلى قطع.

text.en: Upholstery. Which department, and what happens?
The upholstery department. Foam and fabric are added.
Finishing. Which department, and what happens?
The finishing department. The piece is sanded and varnished.
Delivery. Which department, and what happens?
Delivery. The sofa is taken to the customer.
Four departments, four jobs, one piece moving through them.
text.ar: أربعة أقسام، وأربعة أعمال، وقطعة واحدة تمرّ بها.
